summary: Unfold pairEvalY (middle pair or last pair) and apply isAdmissibleEval_finEval with the lattices of the Y_k (spansLattice_gradingY), κ = 1 or δ, δ = conj(c⁻¹)·c for the chosen idele c; the lattice condition hM is inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice for the neighbouring Y's.

steps.claim: For k ≤ 2ϱ + 1 and any j equal to the lattice exponent, gradingY(k).SpansLattice(a, π, (a/ā)^j) (spansLattice_gradingY, rewritten along the equality of exponents).
steps.lean:
have L {k l} j (e : _ =
    j := by grind) := congr(Grading.SpansLattice _ _ _ (_ ^ $e)).mp (D.spansLattice_gradingY k l)

steps.claim: Let δ = conj(c⁻¹)·c, c the chosen idele of π̄_g.
The two pairs (i < ϱ: middle pair; i = ϱ: last pair) are treated together:
steps.lean:
unfold pairEvalY; split_ifs <;> (try lia) <;> apply isAdmissibleEval_finEval (1 ⊕ᵥ (1 ⊕ᵥ fun _ ↦
    ite (i < D.ϱ) 1 δ)) (L (D.ϱ - i).succ) δ (by simp +contextual [δ, chosenIdele, generator_spec,
    places, v_inv, not_isChosen_of_N_mem, ← v_chosenIdele, ← IsChosen.eq_1]) <;> (first
    | rintro s t e x c ⟨o, h, k, a, b⟩ _ rfl (j | j) | simp +contextual [D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces,
      selfOrConj, mem_Ô, piIdele_spec, mem_Ô.1 (generator_spec _).1, chosenIdele, ← v_chosenIdele,
      δ, ↓coe_divStar, ideleA, *, v_inv, division_def] <;> grind [Units.mul_inv, star_one,
      star_mul']) <;> subst_vars <;> [apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L (D.ϱ -
    i).succ) (x ∘ .inl) a; apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L (D.ϱ - i)) (x ∘ .inr)
    b; apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L 1) (x ∘
    .inl) (add_mem a (mul_mem Weil.normNegOne.1.2 b)); revert j] <;> (try simp [univ_eq_empty, xFin,
    reindex_equiv (D.lastGrading D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two).indexEquiv,
    (D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two ▸ D.isStd_spaceY).point_eq_one]) <;> grind
    [star_normNegOne_mul_self, show D.piIdele⁻¹.1 = (_⁻¹ : D.E) by rfl]

steps.claim: Unfold pairEvalY and split into i < ϱ and i = ϱ (i > ϱ is excluded by hi).

Apply isAdmissibleEval_finEval with κ = 1 on the first blocks and 1 (i < ϱ) or δ (i = ϱ) on the last point, the lattice of Y_{2i+1} from step 1, and δ; its hypothesis hN (δ = 1 and π̄_g a unit at the places above N) holds by valuations: the chosen places do not divide N.
steps.lean:
apply isAdmissibleEval_finEval (1 ⊕ᵥ (1 ⊕ᵥ fun _ ↦
    ite (i < D.ϱ) 1 δ)) (L (D.ϱ - i).succ) δ (by simp +contextual [δ, chosenIdele, generator_spec,
    places, v_inv, not_isChosen_of_N_mem, ← v_chosenIdele, ← IsChosen.eq_1])

steps.claim: The remaining hypotheses: for hM introduce s, t, the neighbour vector (o, h, k, a, b) and the index; the algebraic hypotheses (split level of the π-places, IsSplitSquarefree for D.piIdele, δδ̄ = 1, integrality of the weights, κ ∈ {1, δ}, δ = (ᾱ/α)(a/ā)) follow from the definitions of the ideles (simp, grind).
steps.lean:
<;> (first
    | rintro s t e x c ⟨o, h, k, a, b⟩ _ rfl (j | j) | simp +contextual [D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces,
      selfOrConj, mem_Ô, piIdele_spec, mem_Ô.1 (generator_spec _).1, chosenIdele, ← v_chosenIdele,
      δ, ↓coe_divStar, ideleA, *, v_inv, division_def] <;> grind [Units.mul_inv, star_one,

steps.lean:
<;> subst_vars <;> [apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L (D.ϱ -
    i).succ) (x ∘ .inl) a; apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L (D.ϱ - i)) (x ∘ .inr)
    b; apply inv_xFin_mulVec_mem_of_spansLattice (L 1) (x ∘
